source: Radio Mobile unit names, cut at 20 characters by the first import; full names from ARRO, the site list (archive/fred_sites_newfile.csv), the Bureau's SLS and QLD station lists, HDB's flood peaks, the 2024 FldWarn KMZ, and for a few the Bureau's rain and river pages and station metadata
rules: A name is a cut when another list gives its number a longer name whose first 20 characters, trailing space dropped, are the name, read with Rd, Ck and Br spelled out.
The full name is ARRO's where ARRO writes it in mixed case, then the site list's, then the Bureau's re-cased; a trailing Alert becomes AL and Tm becomes TM, as in the rest of the network.
A longer name that only spells out an abbreviation Flood-Net uses on purpose (AL for ALERT, TM, Br, Ck, Rd) is not a cut, and nor is a short form with its bracket closed.
